name: 30% Urea Foot Roll On - 50ml
subtitle: For Cracked & Rough heels
usageInstructions: Apply directly on the underarm skin. Roll evenly on and allow the product to dry completely
description: Meet our 30% Urea Foot & Heel Roll-On — the advanced solution for severe dryness and deep cracks, with the highest Urea concentration in the market! ✨ Why You'll Love It: 🔹 Softens Stubborn Roughness: With 30% Urea, it intensely softens thick, hardened skin and helps eliminate painful cracked heel symptoms 💧 Intense Hydration, Zero Grease: Delivers quick, long-lasting moisture without the heavy or sticky feel. 🩺 Dermatologist-Trusted Formula: Specially designed for very dry, cracked, and rough feet that need more than just a regular cream. ✅ For best results, apply twice daily until cracks and roughness visibly reduce.
usage: Step 1 : Clean your foot and pat dry. Step 2 : Roll the product on foot and massage gently. Allow the product to dry. Use everyday for 3 months for best results.

list.title: How to Use 30% Urea Roll On ?
list.content:
Step 1
Clean your foot and pat dry.
Step 2
Roll the product on foot and massage gently. Allow the product to dry.

list.title: Important Information
list.content: Patch tests are easy to ensure you don't experience any initial adverse reaction when using a new product. We recommend doing a patch test before starting any new product on your skin. You can conduct a patch test by following the below steps:  1. Apply the product to a small patch of skin either to the arm or bend of the elbow   2. Keep the area dry 3. Leave on for 12-24 hours (or lesser if the product isn’t a leave-on product) 4. If any redness, itching, or irritation is observed at any time during the test, do not use the product,; you can safely use it

list.title: Does it help with cracked, rough heels?
list.content: Yes, it does. Urea, present in the product, is a humectant that attracts moisture to the skin, softening and hydrating dry, rough areas. It also gently exfoliates by breaking down dead skin cells, which helps smooth out tough skin patches.

list.title: Does this roll on eliminate foot callous?
list.content: Yes, this 30% Urea Roll On can eliminate symptoms like calluses and heel fissures as it has exfoliating properties.

list.title: How is this different from other foot creams?
list.content: This roll on contains the most potent formulation to treat cracked, rough and dry heels. Urea & Lactic acid present exfoliates dead skin buildup, promotes skin cell turnover, and deeply moisturizes. Roll on format makes it mess-free and convenient to use.

list.title: Is it safe to use?
list.content: Yes, it is 100% safe to use.

list.title: How long will it take to heal cracked heel?
list.content: It depends on the severity, but we recommend to use it daily for 3 months for best results.
